title: Chargers GM Joe Hortiz: "High" priority on Derwin James spending his whole career here

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Chargers GM Joe Hortiz: "High" priority on Derwin James spending his whole career here
sources.description: Safety Derwin James has been with the Chargers since entering the NFL in 2018 and the team would like to see him continue to wear their uniform through the end of his playing days.
